description: This file defines a static utility class 'AzureTableDefaultPolicies' used for configuring default retry and timeout policies for Azure Table storage in the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes constants, static properties, and a static constructor to initialize retry policies based on whether a debugger is attached, with conditions to handle multiple namespace scenarios via preprocessor directives.

classes.name: AzureTableDefaultPolicies
classes.description: Utility class providing default retry and timeout settings for Azure table storage operations within Orleans, including policies for retries, pauses, and timeouts, adapting to debugging scenarios.

methods.name: AzureTableDefaultPolicies
methods.description: Static constructor initializing retry counts, pauses, timeout durations, and retry policies based on debugging state and platform configuration.
